tasks.label: Launch Dolphin DAP
args:
set -e
socket=$1
pidfile=$2
if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
  IFS= read -r old_pid <"$pidfile"
  kill "$old_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
rm -f "$socket" "$pidfile"
nohup "$3" -C "Dolphin.General.DAPSocket=$socket" -C "Dolphin.Debug.SourcePaths=$6" -C "Dolphin.Core.DefaultISO=$4" -C Dolphin.Core.BootExecutableWithDefaultDisc=true --exec "$5" --platform x11 >build/dolphin-dap.log 2>&1 &
dolphin_pid=$!
printf '%s\n' "$dolphin_pid" >"$pidfile"
cleanup() {
  kill "$dolphin_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f "$socket" "$pidfile"
}
trap cleanup ERR INT TERM
until [ -S "$socket" ]; do
  kill -0 "$dolphin_pid"
  sleep 0.1
done
printf 'Dolphin DAP ready\n'

tasks.label: Stop Dolphin DAP
args:
pidfile=$1
socket=$2
if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
  IFS= read -r dolphin_pid <"$pidfile"
  kill "$dolphin_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
rm -f "$pidfile" "$socket"
